Eden Entity is an entity which can be created, edited or deleted in the [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]].

It is not a unique [[Data_Types|data type]]; instead it represents one of the existing types:

|-

| [[Object]] || [[Eden Editor: Object|Eden Editor Object]]
|-

|-
| [[Object]] || [[Eden Editor: System|Eden Editor System]]
|-
| [[Array]] || [[Eden Editor: Waypoint|Eden Editor Waypoint]]
|-
| [[String]] || [[Eden Editor: Marker|Eden Editor Marker]]
|-
| [[Number]] || [[Eden Editor: Layer|Eden Editor Layer]]
|-
| [[Number]] || [[Eden Editor: Comment|Eden Editor Comment]]
